scope_notes: Legacy -3H propagation belongs to spatial ij-Einstein free evolution; new -2H belongs to Raychaudhuri free evolution. Their H derivatives differ by -C/6. Neither can be substituted off the constraint surface.
Equal six-axis weights make the stress tensor isotropic at the control state, not the full discrete distribution invariant under SO(3).
Eliminated reference independently evolves a reduced state and reconstructs H and density, but shares moment evaluation with the free evolution. The review adds explicit six-particle moment sums.
Python/Rust parity covers the shared domain with one to four sectors. Rust also permits zero sectors; Python represents vacuum by a zero-density sector.
Gamma-law repair requires normal-frame P=(gamma-1)Omega and a consistent q override. It does not implement a general tilted constitutive closure.
Finite-family and finite-time checks do not certify arbitrary tilted/curved kinetics, global convergence, production dispatch, or all repository regressions.
